question: How can the power-holder state be set aside while power remains full?
premises: Awareness-Bhairava is satisfied with the mere fullness of being and possesses power.
By its own full power, the distinct state of the power-holder is set aside.
This setting aside occurs within the same powerful reality.
inference: Therefore the distinction between power and power-holder is an internal play of the one full power.
plain_english: In that powerful awareness, satisfied with the mere fullness of being, the state of the power-holder is set aside by its own full power alone.
